sources.label: NAUR LesBin P1 (Role + Fixed Tether Utopia, Conga Fall of Faith)

steps.title: Conga into the first two tethers
steps.cue: Fall of Faith tether and Prey
steps.rule: The 1st and 3rd tethers go west, the 2nd and 4th east. Untethered players line up H1, H2, MT, OT, M1, M2, R1, R2: the first two take west, the next two east. The tethered player stands 5.5m out; red (Sinblaze) tether: both helpers stack tight just behind them; blue (Sinsmite) tether: one helper beside them to the north, one to the south. A second tethered player waiting on the same side stands behind.

steps.title: West side: second tether
steps.cue: First Fall of Faith hit on the west
steps.rule: After the first west hit, the west group reforms the same way on the waiting tethered player, using its colour.

steps.title: East side: second tether
steps.cue: First Fall of Faith hit on the east
steps.rule: After the first east hit, the east group reforms on the waiting tethered player, using its colour.

steps.title: Back under the boss
steps.rule: Regroup close around Fatebreaker in your clock spot for Burnished Glory.

steps.title: Towers and Powder Mark
steps.cue: Burnt Strike cast and towers appear
steps.rule: Towers appear on one edge. H1 takes the north tower, H2 the middle, R2 the south; M1, then M2, then R1 fill the towers still missing players, north first. Lightning Burnt Strike: stand in your tower, clear of the wide line. Fire Burnt Strike: wait 7m in from your tower to get knocked into it.

MainTank.rule: Go to the side away from the towers, north, apart from everyone: the Powder Mark on the OT also hits the nearest player.

OffTank.rule: You hold Powder Mark Trail: go to the side away from the towers, south, with only the MT near you.

steps.title: Hug the line for the knockback
steps.rule: Fire only: step right up to the centre line on your side, level with your tower, so Blastburn throws you into it. Tanks do the same on the far side.

steps.title: Back under the boss
steps.cue: Towers and Burn Mark go off
steps.rule: Regroup around Fatebreaker and burn before the Burnished Glory enrage.
